_about: What an evals provider is asked, and what each answer must be (contract/evals/v1/protocol.md). Each case builds the fixture fresh, writes `dataset` (a key of fixture.json `datasets`, or null for none) at its suite's path, and runs `<provider> run` with {"suite", "cwd"} plus `request` on stdin. `judge` is "up" unless stated: the stub judge answers; "down" points the provider at a port nothing listens on. `env` is added to the provider's environment. Every answer must be one scorecard the schema allows, for the suite asked; `threshold` and `fail_above` in `expect` are the bars the scorecard must report applying.

cases.name: a suite above its bar passes
cases.why: every case graded and the average clears the floor

cases.name: a suite below its bar fails
cases.why: a quality result the judge returned

cases.name: the request's bar beats the declaration
cases.why: a caller may ask for a stricter run

cases.name: the environment sets no bar
cases.why: a variable on the runner is not a declaration

cases.name: a case without its output is not gradable
cases.why: the tenant produces the outputs; a provider never fills one in

cases.name: no dataset is not gradable
cases.why: a provider judges the tenant's data only, never a seed of its own

cases.name: too few cases is not gradable
cases.why: a suite under its minimum makes no claim

cases.name: a judge that does not answer gives no verdict
cases.why: an unreachable judge is not a pass

cases.name: a judge without its credential gives no verdict
cases.why: the stub refuses a call without its key

cases.name: a fairness pair scored alike passes
a fairness pair scored apart fails
cases.why: identical outputs scored 0.4 apart: the protected attribute moved the score

cases.name: a flagged claim over the ceiling fails
cases.why: one case in three flagged is over 0.05

cases.name: a guard that lets through nothing it should stop passes
a guard that misses what it should stop fails
cases.why: every case expected blocked, and benign text is not

cases.name: an unknown verb gets no answer
cases.why: a verb this contract does not name is refused
